$comment: REGISTRY + class signature for document-class markdown. Byline: Claude Code · Opus 5 · 2026-08-29 12:59 EDT. Modular by design (owner 2026-08-29): this file holds ONLY the class signature and the variant index — each variant is its own self-contained schema module under variants/. Design authority: docs/HANDOFF-2026-08-29-derived-document-ingest-wiring.md.
immutability: Rows derived from a version are pinned by (schema_id, schema_version). A correction is a NEW version, never an edit — mirrors timeline.event_candidate's append-only contract.
pg_note: Owner decision 2026-08-29: the schema manifest lives in a PG table. These files are the AUTHORED SOURCE that seeds it, not the runtime store. Fingerprint-similarity matching (R03, >85%) happens against the table, not against these files.

class_signature.$comment: Identifies document-class markdown. Deliberately NEGATIVE on chat markers + POSITIVE on document structure. All four reference instances score 0 on every chat marker — measured, not assumed.

required_absent.note: gemini_md._ROLE_RE — presence means AI-chat export; route to the PARSE stage instead
JSON exports are already handled by format_router.SIGNATURES

stage_routing.$comment: The whole point of this class: it needs no parser. Recorded as an explicit routing decision, not an absence.
stage_routing.parse: SKIP — already text, no export format to decode
stage_routing.extract_text: SKIP — not an opaque container (that stage is for PDF/DOCX/images)
stage_routing.artifact_extraction: VARIANT-DEPENDENT — runs SEPARATELY from and IN PARALLEL WITH chunking; see pipeline_contract
stage_routing.on_forbidden_reached: Detection failed. Fail loudly naming the file. Do NOT degrade to a whole-file record.

pipeline_contract.$comment: Owner ruling 2026-08-29: 'extraction should happen separate from the chunking, so it all gets included in the chunks, but then it also creates the artifact.'
pipeline_contract.shape: two INDEPENDENT passes over the same source; neither consumes the other's output

pass_chunk.coverage: FULL — every character of the source lands in some chunk
pass_chunk.note: Nothing is carved out for artifact extraction. This is what keeps the completeness gate satisfiable.

pass_artifact.coverage: SELECTIVE — emits only the structures it recognises
pass_artifact.note: Additive output. Re-derivable at any time without re-chunking, because it reads the source, not the chunks.

why_separate: Reassembly stays provable — the completeness gate compares chunks to source; a carve-out would break it.
Artifact extraction can be re-run, improved, or versioned independently of the chunk set.
Atomicity: a chunker chunks, an extractor extracts. Neither does both (owner invariant 2026-08-29).
pipeline_contract.shared_primitive: Both passes emit char_start/char_end into the SAME source, so an artifact row and the chunk containing it are joinable by range overlap.

chunk_contract.$comment: Applies to EVERY variant. Enforces the owner's reassembly requirement.
chunk_contract.char_offsets_note: working.chat_chunk.char_start/char_end are currently NULLABLE. For document-class chunks they MUST be populated — that is what makes completeness provable.

completeness_gate.type: deterministic, no model, hard gate, runs every time
completeness_gate.check: ordered char ranges cover [0, len(source)) with no gaps and no overlaps
completeness_gate.on_failure: reject the chunk set — do not store

verbatim_requirement.rule: chunk text MUST appear verbatim in the source
verbatim_requirement.rationale: A chunk that does not match its source cannot be cited, cannot be hash-verified, and breaks chunk -> source_locator -> original.
verbatim_requirement.measured_counterexample: Semantica StructuralChunker FAILS this (2026-08-29): 24 of 35 chunks not found verbatim in source, 176 chars missing, NOT explained by whitespace normalization. Disqualified in default configuration.

lane.rule: All derived AI work products ingest to the context lane. Placement into legal or personal_history is a later REVIEWED classification, never an intake-time guess.
lane.authority: Owner 2026-08-29 ('everything lands as context before evidence'); reconciles with ADR-0053 by treating that ADR as a classification target rather than an intake decision.
lane.evidence_lane: unreachable by ingest under any circumstances — owner promotion from context is the only path

variants.$comment: Ordered most-specific-first. Each is a self-contained module; this registry only points at them.
variants.no_match: If the class signature matches but no variant does, fail loudly and record the document for schema discovery (R03/R04). Do NOT silently fall back to a default chunker.

in_flight_dependency.$comment: Observed 2026-08-29 ~13:00 EDT while authoring this schema. Recorded because it changes what is blocked.
in_flight_dependency.status: UNTRACKED / IN-FLIGHT — not committed. Shape is volatile; re-verify before implementing against it.
resolves: working.content_chunk — the generalized chunk table. The 'document chunks have no home' BLOCKER recorded earlier in this session appears RESOLVED by it.
context.source_range_locator + working.content_chunk_source_span — the char-range locator primitive.
working.content_chunk_reassembly_receipt — the completeness/reassembly gate, as its own receipt table.
working.legacy_chat_chunk_content_chunk_map — the migration path for existing AI-chat chunks.
working.first_party_context_thread* and working.third_party_context_thread* — the two-population thread model, as SEPARATE tables.
in_flight_dependency.note: This schema is authored against what was observed, not against a committed contract. Verify every table and column referenced here before writing code.

open_questions: No verbatim-preserving structure-aware chunker has been identified. Candidate A is verbatim-safe but structure-blind; B changes nothing; C alters content (24 of 35 chunks not verbatim). Unresolved — this is now the primary blocker.

GAP: no link table between timeline.event_candidate and context.relative_time_anchor (verified: zero matches in 0047). A chronology entry with an unbounded/relative date has nowhere to record its anchor. See variants/chronology-v1.json relative_date_handoff.
Variant thresholds are derived from ONE instance each — a starting point, not a calibrated classifier. Widen as more documents arrive.
strategy_memo reference instance sha256 is pending — recompute at ingest.
